title: Into the Glacier — performance inside the Langjökull ice chamber
bio: Guests enter 500+ metres of paths carved through layers of blue glacial ice more than 10,000 years old, descending into an ice chamber where the natural acoustics of the crystal caves become the venue. Includes roundtrip transport from the festival and a short tour of the glacier cave system.

title: The Lava Cave — acoustic set inside Vatnshellir, an 8,000-year-old lava tube
bio: An intimate, acoustic performance inside Vatnshellir Lava Cave, an 8,000-year-old lava tube beside the Snæfellsjökull stratovolcano — the fictional gateway to the subterranean world in Jules Verne's Journey to the Centre of the Earth. Includes roundtrip transport from the festival.

title: Ingjaldshólskirkja — midday concert in the historic church near the festival grounds
bio: An intimate midday performance inside Ingjaldshólskirkja, a historic church just a short walk from the festival grounds. Högni rose to prominence with Hjaltalín and GusGus and has become one of Iceland's most celebrated contemporary composers.
